title: The Appraiser on the Volcano Rim
story: On the rim of a smoking volcano, Obelquin the Pumice Appraiser runs the ember bazaar and holds the key to Cinderhollow's seed vault, which he will sell back for 400 ember coins. Mr 6 has twelve obsidian mirrors to trade, and Obelquin's crooked scales are already grinning. Mr 6 asks, very politely, to see the fee list.
question: Obelquin pays 45 ember coins for each of the 12 mirrors, then subtracts a 20% heat tax from the total and one flat crate fee of 15 ember coins. How many ember coins does Mr 6 walk away with?
solution: The mirrors are worth 12 × 45 = 540 ember coins.
The heat tax takes 20%, leaving 540 × 0.8 = 432 coins.
Subtract the crate fee: 432 - 15 = 417 ember coins.
praise: Finding the full value of the mirrors first was exactly the right opening move — the fees just needed to be peeled off one at a time.
hint: Work the fees in order: total value first, then take away 20%, then the flat crate fee.
victory: 417 coins — seventeen more than the key's price, and Mr 6 counted every one aloud. Obelquin shrank two sizes from sheer honesty-shock and handed over the seed vault key, plus a free crate, fee included.
imagePrompt: A pumice-skinned appraiser monster hunched over crooked brass scales at a glowing lava-rim bazaar at dusk, while a small numeral-six knight stacks gleaming obsidian mirrors and tallies coins on a slate.
